paragraphs.source_en: After a little while, my master muttered to himself, "Hm, it is a terribly ugly face." For him to acknowledge his own ugliness is, indeed, rather admirable. Judging by his manner, the act was certainly that of a madman, but what he said was the truth. If he were to go one step further, he would grow frightened at his own hideousness. Unless a man feels, through and through, the fact that he himself is a dreadful villain, he cannot be called a man seasoned by life. And if he is not such a seasoned man, he can never attain liberation. Since my master had come this far, one might have expected him, with just one step more, to add, "Oh, how frightening!" But he would not say it. After saying only, "It is a terribly ugly face," who knows what came into his head, but he puffed out his cheeks with a great "poof." Then he slapped the swollen cheeks two or three times with the palm of his hand. What sort of charm this was, I cannot tell. At that moment I had the feeling that there was another face that resembled this one; after thinking it over carefully, I realized it was the face of Osan, the maid. Since it comes to mind, I may as well say a word about Osan's face: it is, I assure you, wonderfully swollen and round. Not long ago, someone brought my master's household a blowfish-shaped lantern bought at Anamori Inari Shrine as a souvenir. Osan's cheeks are swollen just like that blowfish lantern, round and bulging all over. They are so outrageously puffed up that one cannot tell where her two eyes have gone. Of course, a blowfish swells evenly into a perfect sphere; but with Osan, whose skull is polygonal to begin with, the fat of her face expands according to that bone structure, so that she looks exactly like a hexagonal wall clock that has suffered from damp. If Osan heard this, I have no idea how angry she would be, so I shall leave Osan there and return to my master. Thus, having puffed his cheeks as high as possible with all the air in his mouth, and, as I said before, slapping them with his palm, he muttered to himself, "When the skin is stretched this tight, the pockmarks don't show."

units.source_en: After a little while, my master muttered to himself, "Hm, it is a terribly ugly face."
units.source_zh: 又过了一会儿，主人自言自语地说：“嗯，模样儿是怪难看的。”

units.source_en: For him to acknowledge his own ugliness is, indeed, rather admirable.
units.source_zh: 他能自己承认自己的丑陋，的确很难得的嘛。

units.source_en: Judging by his manner, the act was certainly that of a madman, but what he said was the truth.
units.source_zh: 从他那神态看，的确是疯癫的动作，不过他说的话，倒是真理。

units.source_en: If he were to go one step further, he would grow frightened at his own hideousness.
units.source_zh: 如果再前进一步，那就会对自己的丑恶感到害怕。

units.source_en: Unless a man feels, through and through, the fact that he himself is a dreadful villain, he cannot be called a man seasoned by life.
units.source_zh: 一个人如果不彻底感觉到自己是个可怕的坏蛋，那么还不能说是个久经世故的人。

units.source_en: And if he is not such a seasoned man, he can never attain liberation.
units.source_zh: 不是个久经世故的人，那么毕竟是不能解脱的。

units.source_en: Since my master had come this far, one might have expected him, with just one step more, to add, "Oh, how frightening!"

units.source_en: But he would not say it.
After saying only, "It is a terribly ugly face," who knows what came into his head, but he puffed out his cheeks with a great "poof."
units.source_zh: 只是在说了句“模样儿怪难看的”之后，也不知他是怎样想的，把腮帮子“噗——”的鼓了起来。

units.source_en: Then he slapped the swollen cheeks two or three times with the palm of his hand.
units.source_zh: 然后用手心把鼓起来的腮帮子拍打了两三下。

units.source_en: What sort of charm this was, I cannot tell.
units.source_zh: 也不知这是哪一种咒术。

units.source_en: At that moment I had the feeling that there was another face that resembled this one; after thinking it over carefully, I realized it was the face of Osan, the maid.

ja.t: たものがあるらしいと

units.source_zh: 这时我感到另有一张脸和这张脸似乎很相像，我想来想去，原来是厨娘阿三的那张脸。

units.source_en: Since it comes to mind, I may as well say a word about Osan's face: it is, I assure you, wonderfully swollen and round.

ja.t: するが、それはそれはふくれたものである。

units.source_zh: 因为是顺便，我不妨提一提阿三的那张脸，那可真是圆鼓鼓的哩。

units.source_en: Not long ago, someone brought my master's household a blowfish-shaped lantern bought at Anamori Inari Shrine as a souvenir.
units.source_zh: 不久以前，有人从穴守稻荷神社那里买来了一件河豚形的灯笼作为礼品送给主人家。

units.source_en: Osan's cheeks are swollen just like that blowfish lantern, round and bulging all over.

ja.t: のようにふくれている。

units.source_zh: 阿三的那腮帮子恰像河豚灯笼那样，鼓得浑圆浑圆。

units.source_en: They are so outrageously puffed up that one cannot tell where her two eyes have gone.
units.source_zh: 由于鼓得太狠，不知把她那两只眼弄到哪里去了。

units.source_en: Of course, a blowfish swells evenly into a perfect sphere; but with Osan, whose skull is polygonal to begin with, the fat of her face expands according to that bone structure, so that she looks exactly like a hexagonal wall clock that has suffered from damp.
units.source_zh: 当然，河豚鼓得圆圆的，是始终按浑圆来臌大的，而厨娘阿三呢，她脑袋的骨骼原本就是多角形的，她的胖脸是按她的骨骼臌大起来的，简直就像个经过水浸了的六角挂钟一般。

ja.t: はこのくらいにしてまた

units.source_zh: 阿三听了这话，真不知她会恼火到什么样子呢，所以关于阿三就讲到这里，还是接着讲我的主人吧。

units.source_en: Thus, having puffed his cheeks as high as possible with all the air in his mouth, and, as I said before, slapping them with his palm, he muttered to himself, "When the skin is stretched this tight, the pockmarks don't show."

ja.t: っぺたをふくらませたる

units.source_zh: 他一边尽量利用嘴里的空气使他的腮帮子鼓得老高，并如前所述，用手心拍打着，一边自言自语地说：“只要皮肤这样绷紧，麻子就不显啦。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 又过了一会儿，主人自言自语地说：“嗯，模样儿是怪难看的。”他能自己承认自己的丑陋，的确很难得的嘛。从他那神态看，的确是疯癫的动作，不过他说的话，倒是真理。如果再前进一步，那就会对自己的丑恶感到害怕。一个人如果不彻底感觉到自己是个可怕的坏蛋，那么还不能说是个久经世故的人。不是个久经世故的人，那么毕竟是不能解脱的。主人既然能够做到这种地步，似乎再前进一步，就有可能顺便说出句：“嗳哟，真可怕！”可他就是不说。只是在说了句“模样儿怪难看的”之后，也不知他是怎样想的，把腮帮子“噗——”的鼓了起来。然后用手心把鼓起来的腮帮子拍打了两三下。也不知这是哪一种咒术。这时我感到另有一张脸和这张脸似乎很相像，我想来想去，原来是厨娘阿三的那张脸。因为是顺便，我不妨提一提阿三的那张脸，那可真是圆鼓鼓的哩。不久以前，有人从穴守稻荷神社那里买来了一件河豚形的灯笼作为礼品送给主人家。阿三的那腮帮子恰像河豚灯笼那样，鼓得浑圆浑圆。由于鼓得太狠，不知把她那两只眼弄到哪里去了。当然，河豚鼓得圆圆的，是始终按浑圆来臌大的，而厨娘阿三呢，她脑袋的骨骼原本就是多角形的，她的胖脸是按她的骨骼臌大起来的，简直就像个经过水浸了的六角挂钟一般。阿三听了这话，真不知她会恼火到什么样子呢，所以关于阿三就讲到这里，还是接着讲我的主人吧。他一边尽量利用嘴里的空气使他的腮帮子鼓得老高，并如前所述，用手心拍打着，一边自言自语地说：“只要皮肤这样绷紧，麻子就不显啦。”
